The Greeter deals all affairs at the [[Illegal garbage tunnel races]] in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]] he sold a pair of wings to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. The scales of the [[garbage worm]]s were priced by Greeter who sold them to a small but select market of collectors as sports memorabilia.<ref name="RP">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>
